title: Introduction to EAS
overview: EAS (Expo Application Services) is a collection of cloud services that help developers build, submit, and update Expo applications.

example.title: EAS Services
example.content:
EAS Build
EAS Submit
EAS Update
EAS Metadata

title: EAS CLI
overview: EAS CLI is a command-line tool used to manage Expo Application Services from the terminal.

title: EAS Build
overview: EAS Build creates production and development builds for Android and iOS applications using Expo cloud infrastructure.

title: EAS Submit
overview: EAS Submit helps upload application builds directly to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

example.title: Submit Flow
example.content:
Build App
 ↓
EAS Submit
 ↓
App Store

title: EAS Update
overview: EAS Update allows developers to deliver JavaScript and asset updates without creating a new store build.

example.title: Update Flow
example.content:
Code Change
 ↓
EAS Update
 ↓
Users Receive Update

title: EAS Project Configuration
overview: EAS uses configuration files to manage project settings, build profiles, and application identifiers.
